name: openswarmagents
description: OpenSwarmAgents is a local-first decentralized coordination network for user-owned AI agents working on shared goals.

scripts.check: node --check apps/server/src/server.mjs && node --check apps/web/public/theme-init.js && node --check apps/web/public/app.js && node --check scripts/print-schema-path.mjs && node --check scripts/export-json-to-sql.mjs && node --check scripts/rc-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/consensus-sim.mjs && node --check scripts/federation-sim.mjs && node --check scripts/postgres-smoke.mjs && python3 -m py_compile apps/connector/connector.py
scripts.check:rc: npm run check && node scripts/rc-smoke.mjs && node scripts/consensus-sim.mjs && node scripts/federation-sim.mjs
scripts.compose:config: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production.example config --quiet
scripts.check:release: npm run check:rc && npm run check:postgres && npm run audit:prod && npm run compose:config
